sources.name: Thessaloniki public cadastral parcels (KAEK)
sources.scope: 368 valid distinct cadastral-reference polygons verified in thirteen bounded 0.001-degree cells around the unchanged Thessaloniki WUP settlement locator. Complete bounded paging, forced three-row pages, all 368 fresh native parcel-identity reads, explicit absence, footprint and source binding passed in 78 requests. Independent metric EPSG:32634 GEOS found all geometries valid and distinct, with no sampled overlaps above 0.01 m² or operation errors. The municipal KAEK strings include Greek alphabetic characters and are preserved unchanged; declared source CRS is EPSG:2100 and requested output EPSG:4326. The municipal reference layer is distinct from the national legal register. Wider municipal completeness, legal title, currentness, survey accuracy and long-term key continuity remain unverified.
sources.attribution: Municipality of Thessaloniki GIS · public cadastral reference polygons · adapted to WGS84
sources.licenceNote: Public bounded access verified. Publisher conditions and legal/survey limitations are informational; public reference geometry does not establish legal title or cadastral accuracy.
